verses.t: About what are they asking one another
verses.pickthall: Whereof do they question one another

verses.t: About the great news
verses.pickthall: (It is) of the awful tidings

verses.t: That over which they are in disagreement
verses.pickthall: Concerning which they are in disagreement

verses.t: No! They are going to know
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they will come to know

verses.t: Then, no! They are going to know
verses.pickthall: Nay, again, but they will come to know

verses.t: Have We not made the earth a resting place
verses.pickthall: Have We not made the earth an expanse

verses.t: And the mountains as stakes
verses.pickthall: And the high hills bulwarks

verses.t: And We created you in pairs
verses.pickthall: And We have created you in pairs

verses.t: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose

verses.t: And made the night as clothing
verses.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak

verses.t: And made the day for livelihood
verses.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood

verses.t: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
verses.pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens)

verses.t: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp

verses.t: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
verses.pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water

verses.t: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
verses.pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant

verses.t: And gardens of entwined growth
verses.pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage

verses.t: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time
verses.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time

verses.t: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes

verses.t: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
verses.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates

verses.t: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
verses.pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage

verses.t: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.pickthall: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush

verses.t: For the transgressors, a place of return
verses.pickthall: A home for the rebellious

verses.t: In which they will remain for ages [unending]
verses.pickthall: They will abide therein for ages

verses.t: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
verses.pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

verses.t: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
verses.pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold

verses.t: An appropriate recompense
verses.pickthall: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds)

verses.t: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning

verses.t: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
verses.pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial

verses.t: But all things We have enumerated in writing
verses.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book

verses.t: So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
verses.pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment

verses.t: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
verses.pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement

verses.t: Gardens and grapevines
verses.pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards

verses.t: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
verses.pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age

verses.t: And a full cup
verses.pickthall: And a full cup

verses.t: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood
verses.pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying

verses.t: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account
verses.pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment

verses.t: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse

verses.t: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct
verses.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right

verses.t: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return
verses.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord

verses.t: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust
verses.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust
